title: PD Frontline (Part of RAPSODI GD) Remote Assessment of People With Parkinson's
official: PD Frontline, Part of RAPSODI GD (Remote Assessment of Parkinsonism Supporting Ongoing Development of Interventions in Gaucher's Disease) to Build an Online Trial-ready Cohort of GBA Genotyped People With Parkinson's
summary:
PD Frontline (part of RAPSODI GD) is an online study observational study for People with Parkinson's. The aims are to better understand the genetic nature of Parkinson's and to connect participants to clinical trials and studies, particularly those with a genetic focus.

To do this, participants are offered genetic sequencing for two common genetic risk factors for Parkinson's Disease, the GBA1 and LRRK2 gene, with an at-home sample collection kit. Return postage is free.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Formal diagnosis of Parkinson Disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Confirmation that the individual carries a GBA1 variant (GBA positive). These individuals will be referred to sister-study, RAPSODI.
* History of Parkinsonism (progressive supranuclear palsy, multiple system atrophy, traumatic, manganese toxicity, postencephalitic, vascular PD; drug induced PD; corticobasal degeneration)
* Individuals with another neurological disorder including: dementia, movement disorders, and motor neurone disease.
* Individuals on drugs known to be associated with parkinsonism, including neuroleptic agents (Amisulpride, Chlorpromazine Hydrochloride, Flupenthixol, Fluphenazine Hydrochloride, Haloperidol, Methotrimeprazine, Levomepromazine, Olanzapine, Oxypertine, Pericyazine, Perphenazine, Pimozide, Pipotiazine, Prochlorperazine, Promazine Hydrochloride, Reserpine, Risperidone, Sulpiride, Thioridazine, Trifluoperazine, Zuclopenthixol acetate, Zotepine), plus Bupropion, , Lithium, Methyldopa, Metoclopramide and Sodium Valproate).
